declarations.name: advance
declarations.text:
def advance (V : Domain E) (η : ℝ) (g x : E) : E :=
  project V (x - η • g)

declarations.name: iterate
declarations.text:
def iterate (V : Domain E) (η : ℝ) (g : ℕ → E) (x0 : E) : ℕ → E
  | 0 => x0
  | t + 1 => advance V η (g t) (iterate V η g x0 t)

declarations.name: prediction
declarations.text:
def prediction (V : Domain E) (η : ℝ) (g : ℕ → E) (x0 : E) (t : ℕ) : E :=
  iterate V η g x0 (t + 1)

declarations.name: regret
declarations.text:
def regret (V : Domain E) (η : ℝ) (g : ℕ → E) (x0 u : E) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ t ∈ range T, inner ℝ (g t) (prediction V η g x0 t - u)

declarations.name: advance_sharp_bound
declarations.text:
theorem advance_sharp_bound (V : Domain E) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (g x u : E)
    (hu : u ∈ V.carrier) :
    inner ℝ g (advance V η g x - u) ≤
      (‖x - u‖ ^ 2 - ‖advance V η g x - u‖ ^ 2 - ‖advance V η g x - x‖ ^ 2) /
        (2 * η)

declarations.name: advance_proximal_minimizer
declarations.text:
theorem advance_proximal_minimizer (V : Domain E) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (g x : E)
    (b : ℝ) :
    advance V η g x ∈ V.carrier ∧ ∀ u ∈ V.carrier,
      inner ℝ g (advance V η g x) + b + ‖advance V η g x - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η) ≤
        inner ℝ g u + b + ‖u - x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η)

declarations.name: prediction_mem
declarations.text:
theorem prediction_mem (V : Domain E) (η : ℝ) (g : ℕ → E) (x0 : E) (t : ℕ) :
    prediction V η g x0 t ∈ V.carrier

declarations.name: prediction_prefix
declarations.text:
theorem prediction_prefix (V : Domain E) (η : ℝ) (g g' : ℕ → E) (x0 : E) (t : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ s ≤ t, g s = g' s) :
    prediction V η g x0 t = prediction V η g' x0 t

declarations.name: regret_eq_loss_difference
declarations.text:
theorem regret_eq_loss_difference (V : Domain E) (η : ℝ) (g : ℕ → E) (b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (x0 u : E) (T : ℕ) :
    regret V η g x0 u T =
      ∑ t ∈ range T, ((inner ℝ (g t) (prediction V η g x0 t) + b t) -
        (inner ℝ (g t) u + b t))

declarations.name: regret_sharp_bound
declarations.text:
theorem regret_sharp_bound (V : Domain E) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (g : ℕ → E)
    (x0 u : E) (T : ℕ) (hu : u ∈ V.carrier) :
    regret V η g x0 u T ≤ ‖x0 - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η) -
      ‖iterate V η g x0 T - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η) -
      (∑ t ∈ range T, ‖prediction V η g x0 t - iterate V η g x0 t‖ ^ 2) / (2 * η)

declarations.name: regret_source_bound
declarations.text:
theorem regret_source_bound (V : Domain E) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (g : ℕ → E)
    (x0 u : E) (T : ℕ) (hu : u ∈ V.carrier) :
    regret V η g x0 u T ≤ ‖x0 - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η) -
      (∑ t ∈ range T, ‖prediction V η g x0 t - iterate V η g x0 t‖ ^ 2) / (2 * η)

expandedDomain:
structure Domain (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] where
  carrier : Set E
  nonempty : carrier.Nonempty
  closed : IsClosed carrier
  convex : Convex ℝ carrier
